title: One Curve, Different Weights: AUC, the Brier Score, Decision-Weighted AUC, and the Policy Youden Index
abstract: arXiv:2611.14465v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AUC and the Brier score are standard summaries of a binary risk score, yet they can rank models differently. We introduce a weighted AUC, AUC$_\pi$, which weights each pair of observations by how differently a decision maker with probability of acting $\pi$ treats them. We show that all three are built on weighted averages of one curve, the Youden index $J(t) = \mathrm{TPR}(t) - \mathrm{FPR}(t)$ across cutoffs $t$, and that the averages differ in the weights they put on the cutoffs. Each weights a cutoff by how much something rises across it: for AUC, the distribution of all scores; for the Brier score, the true probability $\mathbb{E}[Y \mid S]$; for AUC$_\pi$, the decision maker's probability of acting. Up to normalization, AUC$_\pi$ is the Brier skill score of the ideal forecast with its weight moved to the cutoffs the decision maker cares about. translated_title: 一条曲线，不同权重：AUC、Brier分数、决策加权AUC与策略Youden指数
translated_abstract: AUC和Brier分数是二元风险评分的标准汇总指标，但它们对模型的排序可能不一致。我们提出了一种加权AUC，记为AUC_π，它根据具有行动概率π的决策者对待每对观测值的差异程度来为各观测对加权。我们证明，这三者都建立在同一条曲线的加权平均之上——即跨截止点t的Youden指数 J(t) = TPR(t) − FPR(t)——而各种平均的区别仅在于它们赋予截止点的权重不同。每个指标都依据某个量跨越该截止点上升的幅度来为其加权：对AUC而言，是所有评分的分布；对Brier分数而言，是真实概率 E[Y|S]；对AUC_π而言，则是决策者的行动概率。在归一化意义下，AUC_π等价于理想预测的Brier技巧分数，只是其权重被转移到了决策者所关心的截止点上。我们还证明，用 |π(s) − π(s′)| 对观测对加权，在尺度变换意义下是唯一的成对加权方式。
tldr: 论文揭示AUC、Brier分数与提出的决策加权AUC（AUC_π）本质上是同一条Youden指数曲线在不同权重下的加权平均，其中AUC_π以决策者的行动概率为权重，从而将模型评估与实际决策需求对齐。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that AUC, the Brier score, and the proposed decision-weighted AUC (AUC_π) are all weighted averages of the same Youden index curve under different weighting schemes, with AUC_π weighting cutoffs by the decision maker's probability of acting, thereby aligning model evaluation with concrete decision-making needs.
